name: Operations Management
original_description: Explore the strategic planning and execution of an organization's core production and service delivery processes. Dive into forecasting demand, managing inventory, optimizing workflows, and leveraging data analytics to drive operational efficiency. Gain hands-on experience with process mapping, capacity planning, and quality control techniques to streamline operations and minimize waste.
new_description: Operations Management explores the principles and practices used to optimize the production and delivery of goods and services. Students will study supply chain management, process design, quality assurance, inventory control, and production planning - the critical elements that enable organizations to efficiently transform inputs into valuable outputs. This course equips learners with quantitative and qualitative tools to analyze operational challenges and devise data-driven solutions.
focus_areas: supply chain management, process optimization, quality control systems, inventory management, production planning

name: Finance
original_description: Explore the intricate world of finance, where you'll delve into the nuances of investment vehicles, portfolio optimization, and risk management strategies. Uncover the power of compound interest, learn to navigate complex financial statements, and master the art of financial planning to achieve your long-term goals. From the basics of budgeting and banking to the intricacies of derivatives and hedging, this dynamic field will equip you with the analytical tools and decision-making skills needed to navigate the ever-evolving financial landscape.
new_description: Dive into the dynamic world of finance, exploring the intricate mechanisms that drive investment decisions, market fluctuations, and corporate financial strategies. Gain a deep understanding of fundamental concepts like time value of money, asset valuation, portfolio optimization, and risk management. Analyze the complex interplay between macroeconomic factors, financial instruments, and investor behavior that shape global financial markets.
focus_areas: investment analysis, financial risk assessment, portfolio theory, capital structure, financial modeling

name: Business Fundamentals
original_description: Delve into the core principles of business operations, from the fundamentals of accounting and finance to the strategic management of organizations. Explore the intricacies of marketing strategies, supply chain logistics, and human resource management. Gain insights into the legal and ethical considerations that shape modern business practices, and learn how to navigate the complexities of entrepreneurship and small business development. Through case studies and hands-on simulations, you'll develop the analytical and decision-making skills needed to thrive in a dynamic, competitive marketplace.
new_description: Explore the fundamental principles, theories, and analytical frameworks that underpin the management and operation of businesses. Delve into key concepts such as organizational structure, financial management, marketing strategies, and human resource practices. Gain a comprehensive understanding of the economic, social, and technological factors that shape modern business environments and inform decision-making processes.
focus_areas: organizational behavior, financial accounting, marketing management, operations management
